Naimuddin Ahmed, J : This miscellaneous case arises out of an application for bail. 

 2. The facts are that on 19.12.92 at about 5-15 A.M. in the morning deceased Kumud Behari Sarker went out of his house for a morning walk. While he was having his morning walk the accused-petitioner Parimal Chandra Sarker along with his co-accused, another six accused per sons, abducted the deceased, took him a distance and then assaulted him by dagger and other deadly weapons and then lei him there with injuries on his person While passing besides the place of occurrence a pedestrian named Abdul Latif sah; him and then raised an alarm. Hear in alarm raised by him Matilal. Sarker Nagendra Chandra Sarkar, Rabat Chandra Sarkar, Manindra Chandp Sarkar, Dilip Chandra Sarkar and other: went there. Kumud Behari Sarkar was removed to Kachua Hospital and getting information about the occurrence till police went there. Kumud Behari Sarka made a statement at the said Hospital and it was recorded by a Police Officer Thereafter, for better treatment Kumu (Behari Sarkar was being removed to the Sadar Hospital, Comilla and on the way t( the hospital he died at about 12.30 A.A14- Informant Tapan Sarkar who happened to be the son of deceased Kumud Behar Sarkar went to Chandina Police Stator and lodged the first information report The Police took up investigation of the case and after completing investigation submit ted charge-sheet against the accused-petitioner and others. The petitioner move( for bail before the learned Sessions Judge Comilla but the learned Sessions Judo rejected his prayer for bail vide his order dated 24.8.93.
